steps.what: Specify geological methods, software behaviour and independent reference cases
Develop applied software implementing the specified geological calculations

loop.purpose: Draft implementation of a specified scientific method
loop.input: Versioned method specification, interfaces and reference cases
loop.output: Code candidate and explanation of assumptions
loop.check: Geoscientist inspects units, equations, numerical behaviour and failure handling against independent calculations
loop.stop: One candidate and one repair; unexplained discrepancies return to manual development
loop.why_not_simpler: Existing native configuration is checked first; remaining implementation requires contextual code construction

steps.what: Test scientific validity and accept the software version for internal use

tasks.design: Test native scientific software configuration before building code in the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded coding loop drafts remaining implementation, while the geoscientist defines methods and independently checks the accepted version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Implementing a scientific method requires detailed coding and debugging.
tasks.enabler_now: Code drafting can assist implementation without establishing scientific validity.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting plausible numerical results produced by an incorrect method.
tasks.human_edge: Define valid science and independently test assumptions.
tasks.altitude: Less implementation typing; method ownership and validation remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Code drafting for geological applications is a model knowledge proposal; the digest supplies no measured case for this task.

assumptions: Boundary is development and internal acceptance, excluding later scientific use and production deployment.

Geoscientist captures equations, units, coordinate/depth conventions, input schema, missing-value handling, tolerances, reference datasets and independently expected results in s1. Time is retained; missing method definitions return to manual specification.
Test native tools and existing libraries before custom code; no new model is placed in the scientific runtime.
Reference cases are independently chosen by the scientist, not accepted from generated tests alone.
unknowns: Method novelty, existing libraries and availability of reference results
research_questions: Does assisted implementation pass independent scientific checks with less total development effort?

already_counted.description: Method specification and reference case capture

incremental.description: Maintain coding instructions and inspect recurrent generated defects

approvals.approved_version: Exact code commit, dependency versions, method specification and validation results; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82 gives18 gross minus7 upkeep=11 net. Novel numerical methods may require manual coding; routine specified transformations may yield3%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Locate geothermal energy prospects by interpreting geological and thermal evidence

tasks.design: Keep geothermal prospect interpretation with the geoscientist using the {OTHER} geoscience analysis software. Earlier data processing belongs to the analysis task and is not counted again here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prospects depend on uncertain subsurface conditions and evidence coverage.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change replaces prospect judgment in this proposal.
tasks.still_hard: Inferring temperature, permeability and viable resource continuity from sparse evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise where evidence supports a prospect and where further investigation is needed.
tasks.altitude: Prospect interpretation and uncertainty assessment remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish temperature evidence from usable resource potential

evidence.claim: The supplied digest does not demonstrate replacement of geothermal prospect interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is prospect interpretation after source analysis; when also recorded as general resource location, roll-up assigns that interpretation once.

Geoscientists produce geological interpretations and field teams produce observations in their existing tasks. No ready-made structured prospect or suitability flag is assumed; judgments are made during s1.
Test native analysis tools before additions; existing runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero upkeep because no new system or workflow is added.
unknowns: Evidence coverage and geothermal development purpose
research_questions: Which missing observations most constrain prospect confidence?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives zero gross and net; sparse and well documented prospects both retain geological judgment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather site evidence and specify carbon sequestration screening criteria
Compare sites with the specified quantitative criteria
Assess uncertainty and identify possible carbon sequestration sites for further investigation

tasks.design: Configure comparison views in the {OTHER} geospatial analysis software using scientist selected criteria. Keep the table descriptive: the geoscientist judges geological uncertainty and which sites merit investigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing a recurring set of numeric criteria requires repeated table and map operations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters and map overlays can repeat specified comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing containment, uncertainty and evidence adequacy.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that a candidate is not a proven safe storage site.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated comparison work; site recommendations remain scientific judgments.

reach.learn: Keep missing evidence visible in screening

evidence.claim: Configured site comparisons are plausible; no supplied case measures carbon storage site screening savings.

assumptions: Boundary is preliminary candidate identification, excluding detailed characterisation, safety approval, permits and operation.

Geoscientist captures site id, coordinates, source/version, selected measurements with units, uncertainty, evidence gaps and explicit threshold rules in s1. Gathering and capture remain fully counted; absent data stay unknown and trigger manual investigation, never a pass.
OTHER means geospatial analysis software. Test native tables, filters and overlays before code; no automated safety or suitability judgment.
Prior analytical processing belongs to source analysis tasks; only repeated site comparison is replaced here.
unknowns: Available site data and whether comparisons are already automated
research_questions: Can configured comparisons expose missing evidence without implying unwarranted suitability?

already_counted.description: Evidence gathering, criteria selection and structured capture

incremental.description: Maintain screening fields and investigate changed sources

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gives25 gross minus8 upkeep=17 net. One-off sites or existing filters yield zero; recurring manual comparisons may yield4%.

tasks.short: Advise on nuclear siting and waste management

steps.what: Provide geological advice on safe nuclear siting or waste management methods

tasks.design: Retain specialist advice grounded in the evidence held in {DOCS}. No automated siting recommendation or waste management advice is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on context, uncertain geology and consequential technical judgment.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest supplies no verified replacement for that specialist judgment.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining long-term uncertainties and limits of the assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Make a qualified recommendation and defend its scientific basis.
tasks.altitude: Advisory work and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Explain uncertainties in hazardous project assessments

evidence.claim: General drafting capability does not demonstrate replacement of nuclear geological advice.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist geological advice, excluding source investigations, regulator decisions and engineering design.

Project specialists produce technical evidence and geoscientists produce geological assessments in existing work. The adviser reads and evaluates them during s1; no precomputed safe-site flag is assumed.
Test existing document retrieval before adding tools; no change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new software or process is introduced.
unknowns: Advisory scope, evidence completeness and local approval process
research_questions: Which claims require additional specialist evidence before advice can be given?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net zero. Both siting and waste management questions retain specialist advice.

role.altitude: Coding and repeated comparisons gain support; geological, geothermal and nuclear judgments remain human.
reach: Work with environmental scientists on uncertainty and evidence gaps
role.ambitious_version: A geoscientist who builds reproducible tools without confusing computed comparisons with scientific assurance.
